notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as The Core

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
